notes.note: Re-review after three small fix rounds in acp-adapter.ts and acp-engine-extension-events.ts: an interrupted Grok wake (provider) turn now lifts its error-notification quarantine on every path (cancel resolving, a target mismatch, cancel throwing); a Grok cost that names no engine prompt is not published; docs/guides/acp.md now says credential-refusal recovery aborts an open wake (engine-restarted, or stopped when stopping) and no longer claims a relaunch does (that path is OpenCode-only). This page states nothing about wake turns, turn-error quarantine or Grok cost. No prose change.
